name: Wayfarer Tongue L13: Reply With Interest

description.value:
Every door you knock on owes you an answer.

When you successfully deliver a Message, you may accept a Reply as a free action. The Reply becomes your next Message automatically and fills your Package slot immediately upon delivery (Pace still refills to max from the just-completed delivery).

The recipient is obligated to provide a Reply if they wish to fully benefit from the delivery you just made — they may decline, but doing so withdraws the L1 delivery effect (no Pace refill, no faction Intrigue OP) and any L11 Package Mastery bonus.

You may decline to carry a Reply. You usually shouldn't.

system.requirements: Route of the Wayfarer Tongue, Shadow Courier Initiation 13

args.body: Every door you knock on owes you an answer. When you successfully deliver a Message, you may accept a Reply as a free action
